data.body: Fixed source-grepping assertions in 6 test files. Approach: (1) test-merge-to-main-config-driven.sh — replaced 8 grep-on-MERGE_SCRIPT assertions with 6 behavioral tests using WORKFLOW_CONFIG_FILE injection + mock binaries to verify _phase_validate actually uses config-specified commands at runtime; (2) test-merge-to-main-ci-workflow-name.sh — replaced 4 grep-on-MERGE_SCRIPT assertions with 3 behavioral tests that source the script in library mode and verify CI_WORKFLOW_NAME resolution + DEPRECATION warning emission; (3) test-merge-to-main-ucq2.sh — deleted 11 structural source-grepping tests (Tests 1-11) covered by existing integration tests 13-17, added 2 behavioral replacements for the ancestor-guard (Test 8) and merge-not-rebase (Test 9) behaviors; (4) test-merge-to-main-version-bump.sh — deleted 1 structural HAS_PHASE_FN grep (covered by the 9 integration tests that call _phase_version_bump directly); (5) test-merge-to-main-cleanliness.sh — replaced Test 7 source-ordering check with behavioral test that verifies git reset HEAD clears staged files; (6) test-merge-to-main-resume-cwd.sh — replaced 5 source-grepping assertions (Tests 1-5) with 4 behavioral tests that invoke each phase from wrong CWD and assert correct results. Remaining awk/sed patterns in test files are all in _extract_fn helpers used to eval+call functions for behavioral testing (not source inspection assertions). All 297 tests pass.
